This application bundles a separate, unmodified ffmpeg.exe (the
"essentials" static Windows build from https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/)
to encode Math Pad board+voice recordings into .mp4 files. It is invoked
as a standalone subprocess -- it is not linked into, and does not share a
process with, this application's own code.

ffmpeg.exe is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3 (GPLv3).
The full license text is included alongside it as LICENSE.ffmpeg.txt.

FFmpeg source code: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
This specific Windows build's source/build scripts: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
